title: FANTASTIC WORKSHOP AT PARK GUELL IN BARCELONA.
text:
Fantastic weekend in Barcelona, (we are from Madrid) , in our visit to Park Guell we signed up for the Trencadis Workshop (it is right next door) and it was an afternoon of learning and crafts super enjoyable and very interesting.
Thank you Marta for your patience with us and your sympathy.
author: e_galipienso

title: Fantastic surprise gift
text: My partner gave me this activity because of my taste for crafts. It was a day success. The time flew by and the treatment very pleasant yet interesting. The techniques of shaping with the ceramic pieces open new avenues of creativity, which generated many expectations to occupy my free time with my next creations at home. A total hit for all audiences.
author: rdM1386EU

title: An Absolute Must-Do Experience in Barcelona!
text:
This mosaic workshop was hands down one of the highlights of our entire trip to Barcelona! After visiting Park Güell earlier in the day, stumbling upon this workshop nearby felt like the perfect way to dive deeper into Gaudí's magical world.
Our instructor was incredibly talented and passionate – they brilliantly explained Gaudí's trencadís technique and how he revolutionized mosaic art. But this wasn't just a lecture; within minutes, we were hands-on, breaking tiles and creating our own masterpieces. title: The best memory of Barcelona and Gaudí.
text:
This activity was quite a discovery. Conducting this workshop with the Artist and Restorer of Mosaic Martha, allowed us to meet Gaudí in all his essence and discover his work. 
A distinct art workshop where time passes slowly. A very enriching activity.
Highly recommended.
author: jlgalipienso

title: Great!
text:
I did the activity with my two daughters, 4 and 8, and they liked it a lot. A beautiful, entertaining activity with a very interesting educational character!!
Marta, the specialized workshopist, a charmer and very professional!! 
I recommend 100%
